header: Pilotwings 64's regular plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, 2-3 minutes with every timeout counted: the
launcher, Load ROM once the shader list Chrome builds behind it is done (a click while it builds is lost, and the game
never starts; Firefox builds none there, and its line saying so is the one waited for), the title, then the hang
glider's first Beginner test started as a player starts it, through the menus (tools/shader_survey.js's go(), which
presses Start and A and writes the vehicle and class at the pilot select, a need that fails the run unless that
vehicle and class are flying), flown 12 s (it is down in about 10) and ended through its results (land()), then the
gyrocopter's first B test (Little States) the same way, flown 52 s: its test runs on its own clock, which land()'s
presses of A don't end, so it comes last. Each vehicle is flown by holding keys for so many ms of the browser's time.
tools/play_plan_extended.json plays the skydive between the two, for when a longer play is needed.
